question: Coringa is a beautiful ______ forest where the Godavari joins the backwaters of Bay of Bengal.
solution:
The correct answer is __**mangrove**__.

__
 
• **Coringa is a beautiful mangrove forest where the Godavari joins the backwaters of Bay of Bengal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary** is a wildlife sanctuary and estuary located near Kakinada in Andhra Pradesh, India.

 
 
• It is the third-largest stretch of **mangrove forests** in India with 24 mangrove tree species and over 120 bird species.
 
• It is home to the critically endangered **white-backed vulture and the long-billed vulture**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Mangrove forests** are home and sanctuaries for many aquatic bird species, including:

 
 
• Pulicat Lake Bird Sanctuary
 
• Mangalavanam Bird Sanctuary
 
• Salim Ali Bird Sanctuary
 
• Pichavaram
 
• **Coringa Wildlife Sanctuary**
 
• Sundarbans National Park
